method:
Q-023's choice C as built: network evaluations a search asks for, along games played by self-play's search
settings (800 simulations with noise on a quarter of the decisions, 150 on the rest, 8 a request, no depth limit,
the move drawn from the visit shares in game round 1 and the most visited after), with and without the fast
searches counting the visits their root holds from the reused tree (count_reused_visits), and the stand-in
network of studies/campaign/runs/speed-256x16-2026-11-24/benchmarks/compare_requests.py: made-up priors and
values from a hash of the position. The two settings play different games once a move differs. Run from the
repository root:
    tmp/gpu-mps-env/bin/python -B studies/campaign/runs/reused-visits-2026-11-25/counted_visits.py OUT.json
